body:
:stop_sign: **Security Risk**: Granting namespace-wide `create`, `delete`, `patch`, `update` permissions on all secrets enables this service account to modify or delete ANY secret in the namespace, including secrets owned by other applications or system components. The PR description justifies GET access for managed secrets during plan/destroy operations, but doesn't explain why unrestricted create/delete/update permissions are required across the entire namespace. If the terraform provider only needs to GET arbitrary secrets, consider restricting this rule to only include the `get` verb while keeping create/delete/patch/update scoped to known secret names via a separate rule with `resourceNames`.[^1]

[^1]: CWE-269: Improper Privilege Management - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/269.html
